symptom: A source manifest with two valid decision digests and only one linked outcome digest could pass the v0.2 cross-ledger preflight as outcomeReferencesLinked=true. Per-list digest/cardinality equality did not prove every manifest decision had a terminal outcome or explicit exclusion.
lesson: Digest equality within a caller-assembled source manifest proves content consistency, not completeness of the decision population. Missing outcomes can silently shrink the apparent comparison denominator even when every supplied outcome is linked.
guardrail: Require one explicit linked outcome per manifest decision before declaring complete cross-ledger linkage; deny unmatched decisions until a versioned frozen exclusion/missingness contract can account for them. Regression-test both a two-decision/one-outcome manifest and a complete two-decision/two-outcome manifest. Do not infer independent settlement finality or scoring authority.
